question: Who took over as the Chief Executive Officer of National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parameswaran Iyer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parameswaran Iyer:**

 
 
• **Born on April 16, 1959, Parameswaran Iyer is an Indian government servant who served as NITI Aayog's CEO from July 1, 2022, to February 28, 2023.**
 
• He was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog in July 2022, succeeding Amitabh Kant.
 
• In 1981, he enlisted in the Indian Civil Services. He voluntarily retired in 2009 to take a position managing the World Bank's water resources.
 
• He joined the Indian government's Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation in 2016, and Prime Minister Modi designated him to lead the Swachh Bharat Mission's initiatives for water management and sanitation.
 
• **He is presently the India's nominee as an executive director in World Bank.**
 
 
 
• NITI Aayog:
 
 
• The Government of India's premier think tank on public policy, NITI Aayog is the nodal agency responsible for promoting cooperative federalism, encouraging economic development, and eschewing bargaining federalism by involving State Governments of India in the formulation of economic policies through a bottom-up methodology. 
 
• **It took over the role of the Planning Commission when it was founded in 2015.**
 
• Chairperson: Narendra Modi, The Prime Minister (ex-officio)
 
• Vice Chairperson: Suman Bery
 
• CEO: B. V. R. Subrahmanyam
 
• HQ: New Delhi, India
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narendra Singh Tomar:**

 
 
• Narendra Singh Tomar is an Indian politician.
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• **At present, he serves as the fifteenth Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• Additionally, he served as a member of Fifteenth Lok Sabha from Morena (2009 - 2014), the Sixteenth Lok Sabha from Gwalior from 2014 to 2019, and the Seventeenth Lok Sabha from Morena from 2019 to 2023.
 
• **Arvind Virmani:**
 
 
• Arvind Virmani, an Indian economist, was born on June 22, 1949.
 
• **He is a full-time member of NITI Aayog since November 2022.**
 
• In 2009, he was designated as the representative of India at the International Monetary Fund.
 
• As the 13th Government of India's Chief Economic Advisor from 2007 to 2009, Virmani authored the 2008–2009 Economic Survey of India.
 
• He is the creator of the non-profit, multidisciplinary EGROW Foundation, which conducts independent, first-rate research in the fields of national security, public welfare, macroeconomic policy, and diplomacy.
